description: This file defines a React component 'Sidebar' for the Mattermost web application, managing the sidebar UI including modals, navigation, and interactions.

classes.name: Sidebar
classes.description: A React component managing the sidebar UI, including modals, navigation, and user interactions within the Mattermost web app.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches categories on mount and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: handleKeyDownEvent
methods.description: Handles keyboard shortcuts for clearing selection and opening modals.

methods.name: showMoreDirectChannelsModal
methods.description: Displays the modal for more direct channels.

methods.name: hideMoreDirectChannelsModal
methods.description: Hides the modal for more direct channels.

methods.name: showMoreChannelsModal
methods.description: Opens modal to browse more channels.

methods.name: showNewChannelModal
methods.description: Opens modal to create a new channel.

methods.name: showCreateUserGroupModal
methods.description: Opens modal to create user groups.

methods.name: handleOpenMoreDirectChannelsModal
methods.description: Toggles the more direct channels modal.

methods.name: closeEditRHS
methods.description: Closes right-hand side if in edit history state.
